info.name: Yasmina SME Medical Insurance (Sandbox)
info.description:
The SME Medical Insurance journey on the sandbox, in order: register a company, browse packages, fetch its employees from its CR and edit them, collect the health declarations, get a price from every provider, issue the policy from the chosen quote, and take payment through the link on the policy.

Before you start, set client_id and client_secret in the collection variables to your sandbox credentials from the portal. Run the requests top to bottom; each one saves what the next needs. Sandbox allows 10 requests a minute, so leave a few seconds between them or set a 7000 ms delay in the Collection Runner.

request.description: Exchanges your client id and secret for a bearer token. The token is saved to the collection and used by every request that follows.

Registers the SME that is buying cover for its employees. The sponsor number is 10 digits; the commercial registration number is 10 digits starting with 7. The company id is saved for the requests that follow.

The packages one insurance provider sells, with what each covers and its yearly price per person. Every provider offers the same four tiers: basic, standard, premium and executive. Change insurance_provider to walaa, alrajhi, tawuniya or malath to see the others; omit it for MedGulf.
Fills the company's employee list with the employees registered under its commercial registration number, each on the basic tier. Fetching replaces the list; the next request edits it.

The full list of employees to cover, each with the tier they chose and any dependents. Sending the list replaces it, so this is how you edit the fetched list. Saudi employees give a national id; everyone else an Iqama, or a border number until their Iqama is issued. sponsor_id and is_married are optional. Birthdates are Hijri for Saudi ids starting with 1, Gregorian otherwise.

request.description: Every employee's own health declaration in one call, named by national id, Iqama or border number. request.description: One response with a quote from each insurance provider, priced for the employees you saved at the tiers they chose, with the price per employee and each tier's benefits and hospital network. Each quote has a quote_price_id; the response id is the quote_request_id. Both are saved so the next request can issue from the first quote. Pick whichever quote the company prefers.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const q = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("quote_request_id", q.id); pm.collectionVariables.set("quote_price_id", q.quotes[0].quote_price_id); }

request.description: Issues the company's policy from the chosen quote. The policy comes back pending payment, with every employee on it and the quoted total as its price. The optional redirect_url is where the customer is sent after paying; policyID in it is replaced with the policy's id.

item.name: 9. Read the policy for the payment link

request.description: Everyone declared before the prices, so payment_link is already on the policy: a short link to Yasmina's secure card page where the company pays for all of its employees in one go. Share it with the customer. It is valid for 24 hours and the same link is returned on every read.
A printable PDF of the health declaration, one page per employee on the policy with their details filled in, for the company to hand out. Use Send and Download in Postman to save the file.
All policies of a company. Omit company_id to list every policy of yours. After payment a policy carries the insurer's policy number and a link to the policy schedule.
